conversation.text: Can you do push-ups?

conversation.speaker: other
conversation.text: Of course I can. It's a piece of cake! Believe it or not, I can do 30 push-ups a minute.

conversation.speaker: me
conversation.text: Really? I think that's impossible!

conversation.speaker: other
conversation.text: You mean 30 push-ups?

conversation.speaker: me
conversation.text: Say, Jim, how about going for a few beers after dinner?

conversation.speaker: other
conversation.text: You know that is tempting but is really not good for our fitness.

conversation.speaker: me
conversation.text: What do you mean? It will help us to relax.

conversation.speaker: other
conversation.text: Do you really think so? I don't. It will just make us fat and act silly. Remember last time?

conversation.speaker: me
conversation.text: I guess you are right. But what shall we do? I don't feel like sitting at home.

conversation.speaker: other
conversation.text: I suggest a walk over to the gym where we can play singsong and meet some of our friends.

conversation.speaker: me
conversation.text: That's a good idea. I hear Mary and Sally often go there to play pingpong. Perhaps we can make a foursome with them.

conversation.speaker: other
conversation.text: Sounds great to me! If they are willing, we could ask them to go dancing with us. That is excellent exercise and fun, too.

conversation.speaker: me
conversation.text: Hey John, nice skates. Are they new?

conversation.speaker: other
conversation.text: Yeah, I just got them. I started playing ice hockey in a community league. So, I finally got myself new skates.

conversation.speaker: me
conversation.text: What position do you play?

conversation.speaker: other
conversation.text: I'm a defender. It's a lot of fun. You don't have to be able to skate as fast on defense.

conversation.speaker: me
conversation.text: Yeah, you're a pretty big guy. I play goalie, myself.

conversation.speaker: other
conversation.text: Oh, yeah? Which team?

conversation.speaker: me
conversation.text: The Rockets.

conversation.speaker: other
conversation.text: Really? I think we play you guys next week. Well, I have to go to practice. See you later.

conversation.speaker: me
conversation.text: How are Zina's new programmers working out?

conversation.speaker: other
conversation.text: I hate to admit it, but they're good. And fast. The Filipino kid is a genius.

conversation.speaker: me
conversation.text: So you'll make the Stars.com deadline, and have us up and running next week?

conversation.speaker: other
conversation.text: It'll be close, but we'll make it.

draft: Good. After Stars.com starts paying us, we won't need Vikam's cash anymore.

conversation.speaker: me
conversation.text: Frank's getting married, do you believe this?

conversation.speaker: other
conversation.text: Is he really?

conversation.speaker: me
conversation.text: Yes, he is. He loves the girl very much.

conversation.speaker: other
conversation.text: Who is he marring?

conversation.speaker: me

conversation.speaker: other
conversation.text: Have they set a date for the wedding?

conversation.speaker: me
conversation.text: Hey Lydia, what are you reading?

conversation.speaker: other
conversation.text: I'm looking at my horoscope for this month! My outlook is very positive. It says that I should take a vacation to someplace exotic, and that I will have a passionate summer fling!

conversation.speaker: me
conversation.text: What are you talking about? Let me see that... What are horoscopes?

conversation.speaker: other
conversation.text: It's a prediction of your month, based on your zodiac sign. You have a different sign for the month and date you were born in. I was born on April 15th, so I'm an Aries. When were you born?

conversation.speaker: me
conversation.text: January 5th.

conversation.speaker: other
conversation.text: Let's see. . . you're a Capricorn. It says that you will be feeling stress at work, but you could see new, exciting developments in your love life. Looks like we'll both have interesting summers!

conversation.speaker: me
conversation.text: That's bogus. I don't feel any stress at work, and my love life is practically nonexistent. This zodiac stuff is all a bunch of nonsense.

conversation.speaker: other
conversation.text: No, it's not, your astrology sign can tell you a lot about your personality. See? It says that an Aries is energetic and loves to socialize.

draft: well, you certainly match those criteria, but they're so broad they could apply to anyone. what does it say about me

conversation.speaker: me
conversation.text: Hi, Becky, what's up?

conversation.speaker: other
conversation.text: Not much, except that my mother-in-law is driving me up the wall.

conversation.speaker: me
conversation.text: What's the problem?

conversation.speaker: other
conversation.text: She loves to nit-pick and criticizes everything that I do. I can never do anything right when she's around.

conversation.speaker: me
conversation.text: For example?

conversation.speaker: other
conversation.text: Well, last week I invited her over to dinner. My husband and I had no problem with the food, but if you listened to her, then it would seem like I fed her old meat and rotten vegetables. There's just nothing can please her.

conversation.speaker: me
conversation.text: No, I can't see that happening. I know you're a good cook and nothing like that would ever happen.

conversation.speaker: other
conversation.text: It's not just that. She also criticizes how we raise the kids.

conversation.speaker: me
conversation.text: My mother-in-law used to do the same thing to us. If it wasn't disciplining them enough, then we were disciplining them too much. She also complained about the food we fed them, the schools we sent them too, and everything else under the sun.

conversation.speaker: other
conversation.text: You said she used to? How did you stop her?

draft: we basically sat her down and told her how we felt about her constant criticizing, and how we welcomed her advice but hoped she'd let us do our things. she understood, and now everything is a lot more peaceful
